import subprocess

# STEP 1: Dynamically extract text from the PDF at runtime
result = subprocess.run(
    ["python3", "skills/OfficeBench/tools/pdf/read_file.py",
     "--pdf_file_path", "/workspace/testbed/docs/handbook.pdf"],
    capture_output=True, text=True, cwd="/workspace"
)
raw = result.stdout.strip()
# Remove the "OBSERVATION: " prefix the tool adds
text = raw.replace("OBSERVATION: ", "", 1)
print(f"Extracted PDF text: [{text}]")

# STEP 2: Split into lines and write each line to a row in the Excel file
lines = [l for l in text.split("\n") if l.strip()]
excel_path = "/workspace/testbed/data/handbook_page1.xlsx"
tool = "skills/OfficeBench/tools/excel/set_cell.py"

for i, line in enumerate(lines, start=1):
    r = subprocess.run(
        ["python3", tool,
         "--file_path", excel_path,
         "--row_idx", str(i),
         "--column_idx", "1",
         "--text", line],
        capture_output=True, text=True, cwd="/workspace"
    )
    print(f"Row {i}: {r.stdout.strip()}")

# STEP 3: Verify by reading the Excel file back
verify = subprocess.run(
    ["python3", "skills/OfficeBench/tools/excel/read_file.py",
     "--file_path", excel_path],
    capture_output=True, text=True, cwd="/workspace"
)
print(f"Verification - Excel contents:\n{verify.stdout.strip()}")
